obernants.domain: Fixed finite Rust fixtures and the production algorithm, observed as per-test pass or assertion failure. The compiler, Rust test runner and successful allocations are trusted. Test acceptance is not unrestricted implementation equivalence.
obernants.observation_scope: One terminating call, or fixed finite test invocation for test sources.
obernants.operator: In the universe of fixture/reference/output triples, acceptance excludes any tested objective mismatch, invalid returned witness or mismatched explicit error payload. Behavior outside the named fixture set is not excluded. This acceptance relation is a finite predicate defined by assertions, not a claim that passing forbids all production bugs.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation; outer inverse restrictions explicitly stated; finite checks do not prove universality.
obernants.assumptions: Successful allocation and trusted Rust/library dependencies; declared input semantics.
